title: 第13章 信王朱由检
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
杀了郑掌班后陈浩立刻将新得到的1个侠客点用在了八步赶蝉上面。
八步赶蝉立时升级到了大成的境界，也算是补足了其脚下速度的短板，刀法的速度再加上脚下的步伐，陈浩自觉论单挑他已不惧这方世界的任何人。
“走！”
这时沈炼也办完了事情，他也没问陈浩为什么要杀郑掌班，这么多年的锦衣卫生涯，他的心比陈浩还冷。
陈浩回到看了眼燃起熊熊烈火的案牍库，点了点头便跟随沈炼离开了案牍库大院。
“这是宝船纪要！”
回到家后，沈炼将宝船纪要交给了陈浩。
陈浩接过后翻看了几页便合了起来，他道：“有了这本宝船纪要，兄长就算是得到了一本通天之门啊，未来的大明皇帝都要欠你的人情。”
“你就这么肯定皇上会驾崩？我觉得信王会先把宝船纪要烧掉，然后再杀我们灭口，郭真死了，宝船纪要被烧掉，咱们俩个火烧案牍库的再被灭口，那皇上落水案就彻底成了无头案，就算神仙也无从查起！”沈炼说出了自己的担忧。
陈浩露出了一个神秘的微笑，模仿着诸葛亮的语气道：“山人自己妙计，我说他不会杀我们，那就不会。”
“你看着办吧。”沈炼说罢就回屋睡觉了，他还真不知道陈浩从哪里来的信心！
沈炼的干净利落再次让陈浩惊讶，心道这沈炼啊不碰到女人还真是条好汉，一旦碰了女人，那智商感人啊！
第二天一如过往，练功，去百户所公干，等待放衙。
陈浩没敢白天去清风茶楼，眼下正值关键时刻，裴纶白天还来明时坊百户所转了一圈，很明显沈炼的嫌疑还没有摆脱。
陈浩倒是不怕，遇到危险的事情可以离开这方世界，可是沈炼咋办，毕竟兄弟一场他不想给沈炼留下什么危机，只好待到晚上再去。
“等等我！”
晚上放衙后陈浩便直接去了清风茶楼，刚刚走过一个街道就听到背后有人喊，转头一看沈炼在他身后愤怒的看着他。
“你为何不等为兄一起前去？”沈炼阴沉着脸，一副我很生气的样子。
陈浩：“......”
我倒是想喊你，你上个茅厕上了得有两小时！

“咱们家如今就剩你我兄弟二人，你敢一个人去送死，为兄也不惧死！”沈炼话里有着一些气愤，但更多的是感动。
得了！原来是误会了！陈浩在心中苦笑，沈炼肯定是觉得信王会杀二人灭口，陈浩之所以一个人去是为了拿宝船纪要给沈炼换一条活路，一旦有变沈炼就可以跑！
陈浩只能说他想多了，他肯主动约见朱由检是有着绝对的把握，而且还会给沈炼带来很大的好处！
“要不我去见信王，你立刻离开京城去广州，无论如何也要给沈家留下一条血脉！”沈炼沉默了片刻又道。
陈浩冲着沈炼微微一笑，非常笃定的道：“小弟自有把握！”
见陈浩下定了决心，沈炼咬了咬牙道：“好，打虎亲兄弟，上阵父子兵，你我兄弟同去，任他是刀山火海也要闯上一闯！”
“不过......”沈炼画风一转，脸色有些难看。
陈浩不解道：“不过什么？”
“不过......为兄先上个茅厕！”沈炼说完便急急忙忙的跑向了就近的一间茅厕。
陈浩：“......”。
清风茶楼就在明时坊百户所的管辖之内，路程倒是挺近的，差不多一炷香的功夫就走到了，丁白缨正在里面等着二人。
“把这个带上！”
二人刚一进入，丁白缨便递给他们两块布条，示意让他们蒙住眼睛。
沈炼没有抗拒接过了布条，信王毕竟身份尊贵，不方面透露行终。
“呵呵，用得着如此隐秘吗？都是一条绳上的蚂蚱了，你以为我们还会出卖你们不成，更何况现在还是在晚上。”陈浩淡淡的说道，根本没有伸手去接布条。
“你......”丁白缨登时就要翻脸，但想到这两个家伙说不定一会就要被灭口了，便忍住了脾气。
随后二人跟随丁白缨上了一辆马车，一路上丁白缨一语不发，沈炼以为大难临头也没说什么话，陈浩倒是闲不住，一会掀开窗帘看看外面的月色，一会又喝口小酒，不知道的还以为他去哪儿郊游呢！
“下车吧！”
马车行驶了半个时辰后来到京城外的郊区，到达一座僻静的院子时丁白缨让二人下了马车。

content_en:
After killing Master Zheng, Chen Hao immediately used the newly obtained knight point on eight steps to catch the cicada.
The eight-step cicada was immediately upgraded to the realm of Dacheng, which could be regarded as making up for his shortcomings in foot speed. The speed of the sword and the pace of his feet made Chen Hao feel that he was no longer afraid of anyone in this world in a one-on-one challenge.
"Let's go!"
Shen Lian had finished his work at this time, and he didn't ask Chen Hao why he wanted to kill Commander Zheng. After so many years in the Jin Yiwei career, his heart was colder than Chen Hao's.
Chen Hao returned and took a look at the blazing fire in the archives. He nodded and followed Shen Lian out of the courtyard of the archives.
"This is the treasure ship's minutes!"
After returning home, Shen Lian handed the treasure ship minutes to Chen Hao.
After taking it, Chen Hao flipped through a few pages and closed it. He said: "With this treasure ship record, my brother will get a copy of the Gate to Heaven. The future Emperor of the Ming Dynasty will owe you a favor."
"Are you so sure that the emperor will die? I think King Xin will burn the treasure ship records first, and then kill us to silence us. If Guo Zhen is dead, the treasure ship records will be burned, and the two of us who burned the records will be silenced, then the case of the emperor falling into the water will become a completely unsolved case, and even gods will not be able to investigate it!" Shen Lian expressed his worries.
Chen Hao showed a mysterious smile and imitated Zhuge Liang's tone: "The mountain man has his own clever plan. If I say he won't kill us, then he won't."
"You figure it out." Shen Lian said and went back to the house to sleep. He really didn't know where Chen Hao got his confidence!
Chen Hao was once again surprised by Shen Lian's neatness. He thought to himself that Shen Lian is really a good man if he doesn't touch a woman. Once he touches a woman, his IQ is impressive!
The next day was as usual, practicing kung fu, going to Baihusuo for business, and waiting to be released from office.
Chen Hao didn't dare to go to Qingfeng Teahouse during the day. It was a critical moment now. Pei Lun also came to Mingshifang Baihu Office during the day. It was obvious that Shen Lian's suspicion had not been shaken off yet.
Chen Hao is not afraid. He can leave this world if he encounters danger. But what should Shen Lian do? After all, he doesn't want to leave any crisis for Shen Lian, so he has to stay until night.
"Wait for me!"
After being released from office in the evening, Chen Hao went directly to Qingfeng Tea House. Just after walking down a street, he heard someone shouting from behind. He turned around and saw Shen Lian looking at him angrily behind him.
"Why don't you wait for my brother to go with you?" Shen Lian had a sullen face, looking like I was very angry.
Chen Hao: "..."
I wanted to call you, it took you two hours to go to the toilet!
"There are only two brothers, you and me, in our family now. You dare to die alone, and you are not afraid of death as a brother!" Shen Lian's words were a little angry, but more moved.
Come on! It turned out to be a misunderstanding! Chen Hao smiled bitterly in his heart. Shen Lian must have thought that King Xin would kill the two of them to silence them. The reason why Chen Hao went alone was to get the treasure ship minutes to give Shen Lian a way to survive. If anything happened, Shen Lian could run away!
Chen Hao could only say that he was overthinking it. He was absolutely sure that he would take the initiative to meet with Zhu Youjian, and it would also bring great benefits to Shen Lian!
"How about I go see King Xin and you leave the capital immediately and go to Guangzhou. No matter what, you must leave a bloodline for the Shen family!" Shen Lian was silent for a moment and then said.
Chen Hao smiled at Shen Lian and said very confidently: "I am sure of myself!"
Seeing that Chen Hao had made up his mind, Shen Lian gritted his teeth and said: "Okay, brothers fighting tigers, father and son soldiers, you and I will go together, no matter how hard it is, we will fight through mountains of swords and seas of fire!"
"But..." Shen Lian's painting style changed and his face looked a little ugly.
Chen Hao asked in confusion: "But what?"
"But... I need to go to the toilet first for my brother!" After Shen Lian said that, he hurried to the nearest toilet.
Chen Hao: "...".
Qingfeng Teahouse is within the jurisdiction of Mingshifang Baihusuo, and the distance is quite short. It takes about one stick of incense to get there.When they arrived, Ding Baiying was waiting for the two of them inside.
"Take this with you!"
As soon as the two entered, Ding Baiying handed them two pieces of cloth, indicating that they should cover their eyes.
Shen Lian accepted the banner without resistance. After all, King Xin had a distinguished status and did not disclose the end of his trip.
"Haha, is there any need to be so secretive? You are all grasshoppers on a rope. Do you think we will betray you, not to mention it is still night." Chen Hao said lightly, without reaching out to pick up the cloth.
"You..." Ding Baiying was about to fall out, but thought that these two guys might be silenced soon, so she held back her temper.
Then the two of them followed Ding Baiying into a carriage. Ding Baiying didn't say a word along the way. Shen Lian thought that a disaster was imminent and didn't say anything. Chen Hao couldn't sit still. He opened the curtains to look at the moonlight outside, and took a sip of wine. He didn't know where he thought he was going for an outing!
"Get out of the car!"
The carriage drove for half an hour and arrived at the suburbs outside the capital. When they arrived at a secluded courtyard, Ding Baiying asked the two of them to get off the carriage.
